newsitem.title: USA: Bufete wins $48.5 mln plant expansion deal.
newsitem.headline: Bufete wins $48.5 mln plant expansion deal.

text.p: Bufete Industrial S.A. said said on Wednesday it was awarded a $48.5 million contract for a turnkey expansion of an electrolytic copper refining plant it was building.
The contract for the original refinery was from Mexicana de Cobre S.A. de C.V. and was valued at $97.5 million, Bufete said in a statement.
Mexicana de Cobre was owned by Grupo Mexico, the country's largest copper producer, Bufete said.
The expansion would increase capacity production to 300,000 metric tons of cathodic copper a year, from 180,000 metric tons, it said.
The plant, which was sheduled for completion in March 1998, would serve the domestic and international markets and would be located near the "La Caridad" smelter in Nacozari-Sonora, Mexico.
